inlines.v: REDEMI'SE, verb transitive s as z. [re and demise.] To convey or transfer back, as an estate in fee simple, fee tail, for life or a term of years. REDEMI'SE, noun Reconveyance; the transfer of an estate back to the person who has demised it; as the demise and redemise of an estate in fee simple, fee tail, or for life or years, by mutual leases.
